claims.text: _parts rejects non-absolute, scheme-bearing, encoded-slash and dot-segment URL paths and maps root to index.html.
resolve_asset lstats each path component under root and requires directories except for the final regular file.
_read_asset reopens the asset through pinned root-relative descriptors with no-follow flags before reading bytes.
_bootstrap strips lineage-session-token metas from index HTML and injects one fresh token meta into head.

decision.rule: Change here when URL confinement, asset lookup, descriptor reads, MIME mapping or bootstrap injection needs to change.
decision.failure: A traversal or encoded separator escapes root, a symlink is followed, or the bootstrap leaves a stale token.

questions.q: Where is a static URL path confined and rejected before lookup?
Where should I change MIME types or bootstrap token injection?
Where can I debug a static asset read failure after resolution succeeds?
